lifecycle: every stored credential lands `pending_test`; a real connection check per provider then flips it to `active`, records `invalid`, or - when the provider could not be reached at all - leaves it `pending_test` as unproven rather than broken

redaction.policy: Explicitly public configuration identifiers are recorded as-is; credential material is never committed; tenant primary keys and internal infrastructure hostnames are digested unless the literal value is needed to reproduce or interpret the evidence. See release-path-playbook.md section 4.
digested: organizationId -> organizationDigest (tenant primary key; the digest is stable, so identity and consistent scoping remain verifiable across artifacts)
traditional_gu_mongo config.host -> config.hostDigest (Atlas cluster hostname; the declared database name is retained because it is the semantic source of record)
unchanged: Gu OS staging Supabase project ref - explicitly classified a public identifier
legacy Firestore project and read-identity email - required to state which identity performed the read
